# Load packages

```{r packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library("tidyverse")  # data preparation and plots
library("lmerTest")   # linear mixed models
library("emmeans")    # condition comparisons
library("boot")       # participant bootstrap mediation
library("knitr")      # tables

```

# Settings

```{r settings}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = FALSE,
                     error = FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5,
                     out.width = "100%")
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 18))
condition_colors = c("Agency" = "#E41A1C", "Compliance" = "#377EB8")
results = list()
primary = list()

show_table = function(x) {
  x = as.data.frame(x)
  for (name in intersect(names(x), c("p.value", "Pr(>F)", "p_GG"))) {
    x[[name]] = ifelse(x[[name]] < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", x[[name]]))
  }
  knitr::kable(x, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
}

```

# STUDY 1

## DATA

### Read in data

```{r study1-read}

raw.study1 = read_csv("../../data/main/study1/study1.csv") %>%
  rename_with(str_trim)

df.study1 = raw.study1 %>%
  filter(Exclusion == 0, Finished == 1) %>%
  mutate(participant = factor(ID),
         condition = factor(Condition, levels = c(1, 2),
                            labels = c("Agency", "Compliance")))

stopifnot(nrow(df.study1) == 148, !anyDuplicated(df.study1$participant),
          !anyNA(df.study1$condition), all(df.study1$Finished == 1))

```

### Wrangle

```{r study1-wrangle}

# Unchecked boxes are zero for the included completed surveys.
items.study1 = df.study1 %>%
  select(participant, condition, matches("^SabotageBehaviorV[123]Q[1-5]$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition),
               names_to = c("vignette", "item"),
               names_pattern = "SabotageBehaviorV([123])Q([1-5])",
               values_to = "endorsement") %>%
  mutate(endorsement = replace_na(endorsement, 0))

stopifnot(all(items.study1$endorsement %in% 0:1))

long.study1 = items.study1 %>%
  group_by(participant, condition, vignette) %>%
  summarise(score = sum(endorsement), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(vignette = factor(vignette))

df.study1 = df.study1 %>%
  left_join(long.study1 %>%
              select(participant, vignette, score) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = vignette, values_from = score,
                          names_prefix = "sabotage_"),
            by = "participant") %>%
  mutate(total_sabotage = sabotage_1 + sabotage_2 + sabotage_3,
         sabotage = total_sabotage / 3)

stopifnot(all(df.study1$sabotage_1 == df.study1$SabotageBehaviorV1Sum),
          all(df.study1$sabotage_2 == df.study1$SabotageBehaviorV2Sum),
          all(df.study1$sabotage_3 == df.study1$SabotageBehaviorV3Sum),
          all(abs(df.study1$sabotage - df.study1$SabotageBehaviorAvg) < 1e-6))

results$study1 = list(descriptives = df.study1 %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(total_sabotage), sd = sd(total_sabotage)))

```

## STATS

### Linear mixed models

```{r study1-models}

fit.study1.sabotage = lmer(
  score ~ condition * vignette + (1 | participant),
  data = long.study1)

summary(fit.study1.sabotage)

```

### Follow up comparisons

```{r study1-comparisons}

means.study1.sabotage = emmeans(fit.study1.sabotage, ~ condition, weights = "equal")
comparison.study1.sabotage = summary(pairs(means.study1.sabotage), infer = TRUE)
comparison.study1.sabotage

joint_tests(fit.study1.sabotage, weights = "equal")

primary$study1 = list(contrasts = bind_rows(as_tibble(comparison.study1.sabotage) %>% mutate(outcome = "sabotage")))

primary$study1$tests = bind_rows(as_tibble(joint_tests(fit.study1.sabotage, weights = "equal")) %>% mutate(outcome = "sabotage"))

```

### Means and confidence intervals

```{r study1-means}

descriptives.study1 = df.study1 %>%
  select(participant, condition, sabotage) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(outcome, condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(score), sd = sd(score))

show_table(descriptives.study1)
primary$study1$descriptives = descriptives.study1

plot.means.study1 = descriptives.study1 %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n),
         lower = mean - qt(.975, n - 1) * se,
         upper = mean + qt(.975, n - 1) * se) %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("sabotage", "deescalation"),
                          labels = c("Sabotage", "De-escalation")))

show_table(plot.means.study1)
primary$study1$means = plot.means.study1

```

## PLOTS

```{r study1-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}

plot.data.study1 = df.study1 %>%
  select(participant, condition, sabotage) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("sabotage", "deescalation"),
                          labels = c("Sabotage", "De-escalation")))

plot.counts.study1 = plot.data.study1 %>%
  group_by(outcome, condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(participant), .groups = "drop")

plot.study1 = ggplot(plot.data.study1, aes(condition, score, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = .16, height = 0, seed = 1),
             alpha = .18, size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(data = plot.means.study1,
                aes(y = mean, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                width = .10, linewidth = .8, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = plot.means.study1, aes(y = mean),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 4, stroke = 1) +
  geom_text(data = plot.counts.study1,
            aes(y = -.80, label = paste0("n=", n)),
            color = "#333333", size = 4.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of sabotage\nactions selected\n(average per scenario)") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, lineheight = .95),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 25, 5.5))

plot.study1

ggsave("../../figures/main/study1/study1.pdf", plot.study1,
       width = 7, height = 5, bg = "white")
ggsave("../../figures/main/study1/study1.png", plot.study1,
       width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

```

# STUDY 2

## DATA

### Read in data

```{r study2-read}

raw.study2 = read_csv("../../data/main/study2/study2.csv") %>%
  rename_with(str_trim)

df.study2 = raw.study2 %>%
  filter(Exclusion == 0) %>%
  mutate(participant = factor(ResponseId),
         condition = factor(Condition, levels = c(1, 2),
                            labels = c("Agency", "Compliance")))

stopifnot(nrow(df.study2) == 278, !anyDuplicated(df.study2$participant),
          !anyNA(df.study2$condition), all(df.study2$Finished == 1))

```

### Wrangle

```{r study2-wrangle}

# Average answered items within each vignette; give the three vignettes equal weight.
items.study2 = df.study2 %>%
  select(participant, condition, matches("^(Sab|De)V[123]_[1-5]$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition),
               names_to = c("outcome", "vignette", "item"),
               names_pattern = "(Sab|De)V([123])_([1-5])",
               values_to = "rating") %>%
  mutate(outcome = recode(outcome, Sab = "sabotage", De = "deescalation"))

stopifnot(all(is.na(items.study2$rating) | items.study2$rating %in% 1:5))

long.study2 = items.study2 %>%
  group_by(participant, condition, outcome, vignette) %>%
  summarise(score = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(vignette = factor(vignette))

supplied.study2 = df.study2 %>%
  select(participant, matches("^(Sab|De)V[123]Avg$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-participant,
               names_to = c("outcome", "vignette"),
               names_pattern = "(Sab|De)V([123])Avg",
               values_to = "supplied") %>%
  mutate(outcome = recode(outcome, Sab = "sabotage", De = "deescalation"),
         vignette = factor(vignette))

check.study2 = left_join(long.study2, supplied.study2,
                       by = c("participant", "outcome", "vignette"))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(check.study2$score)),
          all(abs(check.study2$score - check.study2$supplied) < 1e-6))

df.study2 = df.study2 %>%
  left_join(long.study2 %>%
              select(participant, outcome, vignette, score) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = c(outcome, vignette), values_from = score),
            by = "participant") %>%
  mutate(sabotage = (sabotage_1 + sabotage_2 + sabotage_3) / 3,
         deescalation = (deescalation_1 + deescalation_2 + deescalation_3) / 3)

results$study2 = list(descriptives = df.study2 %>%
  select(condition, sabotage, deescalation) %>%
  pivot_longer(-condition, names_to = "outcome") %>%
  group_by(outcome, condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)))

```

## STATS

### Linear mixed models

```{r study2-models}

fit.study2.sabotage = lmer(
  score ~ condition * vignette + (1 | participant),
  data = filter(long.study2, outcome == "sabotage"))

summary(fit.study2.sabotage)

fit.study2.deescalation = lmer(
  score ~ condition * vignette + (1 | participant),
  data = filter(long.study2, outcome == "deescalation"))

summary(fit.study2.deescalation)

```

### Follow up comparisons

```{r study2-comparisons}

means.study2.sabotage = emmeans(fit.study2.sabotage, ~ condition, weights = "equal")
comparison.study2.sabotage = summary(pairs(means.study2.sabotage), infer = TRUE)
comparison.study2.sabotage

joint_tests(fit.study2.sabotage, weights = "equal")

means.study2.deescalation = emmeans(fit.study2.deescalation, ~ condition, weights = "equal")
comparison.study2.deescalation = summary(pairs(means.study2.deescalation), infer = TRUE)
comparison.study2.deescalation

joint_tests(fit.study2.deescalation, weights = "equal")

primary$study2 = list(contrasts = bind_rows(as_tibble(comparison.study2.sabotage) %>% mutate(outcome = "sabotage"),
  as_tibble(comparison.study2.deescalation) %>% mutate(outcome = "deescalation")))

primary$study2$tests = bind_rows(as_tibble(joint_tests(fit.study2.sabotage, weights = "equal")) %>% mutate(outcome = "sabotage"),
  as_tibble(joint_tests(fit.study2.deescalation, weights = "equal")) %>% mutate(outcome = "deescalation"))

```

### Means and confidence intervals

```{r study2-means}

  select(participant, condition, sabotage, deescalation) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(outcome, condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(score), sd = sd(score))

show_table(descriptives.study2)
```

## DATA

```{r study3a-means}
primary$study3a$means = plot.means.study3a

```

### Mediation

```{r study3a-mediation}

df = df.study3a

mediation_results = list()
for (outcome_name in c("sabotage", "deescalation")) {
  prefix = ifelse(outcome_name == "sabotage", "Sab", "De")
  reason = ifelse(outcome_name == "sabotage", "Des", "Obl")
  m = rowMeans(df[paste0(prefix, "V", 1:3, "_", reason)])
  stopifnot(all(abs(m - df[[paste0(prefix, reason, "Avg")]]) < 1e-6))
  items = unlist(lapply(1:3, function(v) paste0(prefix, "V", v, "_", 1:5)))
  y = rowMeans(df[items], na.rm = TRUE)
  stopifnot(all(abs(y - df[[paste0(prefix, "Avg")]]) < 1e-6))
  d = data.frame(y = y, m = m, agency = as.numeric(df$condition == "Agency"))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d))
  fit_m = lm(m ~ agency, data = d)
  fit_y = lm(y ~ agency + m, data = d)


  # Resample participants; all computations remain in this Rmd.
  statistic = function(data, index) {
    b = data[index, ]
    a = lm.fit(cbind(1, b$agency), b$m)$coefficients[2]
    by = lm.fit(cbind(1, b$agency, b$m), b$y)$coefficients
    c(indirect = unname(a * by[3]), direct = unname(by[2]),
      total = unname(by[2] + a * by[3]))
  }
  set.seed(20260906)
  bootstrap = boot(d, statistic = statistic, R = 5000)
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(bootstrap$t)))
  intervals = apply(bootstrap$t, 2, quantile, probs = c(.025, .975))
  mediation_results[[outcome_name]] = tibble(
    outcome = outcome_name, mediator = ifelse(reason == "Des", "deservingness", "obligation"),
    effect = c("indirect", "direct", "total"),
    estimate = bootstrap$t0, lower = intervals[1, ], upper = intervals[2, ])
}
mediation_results = bind_rows(mediation_results)

results$study3a$mediation = mediation_results

show_table(mediation_results)

```

# STUDY 3B

## DATA

### Read in data

```{r study3b-read}

raw.study3b = read_csv("../../data/main/study3/b/study3b.csv") %>%
  rename_with(str_trim)

df.study3b = raw.study3b %>%
  filter(Exclusion == 0) %>%
  mutate(participant = factor(ResponseId),
         condition = factor(Condition, levels = c(1, 2),
                            labels = c("Agency", "Compliance")))

stopifnot(nrow(df.study3b) == 259, !anyDuplicated(df.study3b$participant),
          !anyNA(df.study3b$condition), all(df.study3b$Finished == 1))
stopifnot(all(df.study3b$FullTime == 1), all(df.study3b$CustomerFacing == 1))

```

### Wrangle

```{r study3b-wrangle}

# Average answered items within each vignette; give the three vignettes equal weight.
items.study3b = df.study3b %>%
  select(participant, condition, matches("^(Sab|De)V[123]_[1-5]$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition),
               names_to = c("outcome", "vignette", "item"),
               names_pattern = "(Sab|De)V([123])_([1-5])",
               values_to = "rating") %>%
  mutate(outcome = recode(outcome, Sab = "sabotage", De = "deescalation"))

stopifnot(all(is.na(items.study3b$rating) | items.study3b$rating %in% 1:5))

long.study3b = items.study3b %>%
  group_by(participant, condition, outcome, vignette) %>%
  summarise(score = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(vignette = factor(vignette))

supplied.study3b = df.study3b %>%
  select(participant, matches("^(Sab|De)V[123]Avg$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-participant,
               names_to = c("outcome", "vignette"),
               names_pattern = "(Sab|De)V([123])Avg",
               values_to = "supplied") %>%
  mutate(outcome = recode(outcome, Sab = "sabotage", De = "deescalation"),
         vignette = factor(vignette))

check.study3b = left_join(long.study3b, supplied.study3b,
                       by = c("participant", "outcome", "vignette"))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(check.study3b$score)),
          all(abs(check.study3b$score - check.study3b$supplied) < 1e-6))

df.study3b = df.study3b %>%
  left_join(long.study3b %>%
              select(participant, outcome, vignette, score) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = c(outcome, vignette), values_from = score),
            by = "participant") %>%
  mutate(sabotage = (sabotage_1 + sabotage_2 + sabotage_3) / 3,
         deescalation = (deescalation_1 + deescalation_2 + deescalation_3) / 3)

results$study3b = list(descriptives = df.study3b %>%
  select(condition, sabotage, deescalation) %>%
  pivot_longer(-condition, names_to = "outcome") %>%
  group_by(outcome, condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)))

```

## STATS

### Linear mixed models

```{r study3b-models}

fit.study3b.sabotage = lmer(
  score ~ condition * vignette + (1 | participant),
  data = filter(long.study3b, outcome == "sabotage"))

summary(fit.study3b.sabotage)

fit.study3b.deescalation = lmer(
  score ~ condition * vignette + (1 | participant),
  data = filter(long.study3b, outcome == "deescalation"))

summary(fit.study3b.deescalation)

```

### Follow up comparisons

```{r study3b-comparisons}

means.study3b.sabotage = emmeans(fit.study3b.sabotage, ~ condition, weights = "equal")
comparison.study3b.sabotage = summary(pairs(means.study3b.sabotage), infer = TRUE)
comparison.study3b.sabotage

joint_tests(fit.study3b.sabotage, weights = "equal")

means.study3b.deescalation = emmeans(fit.study3b.deescalation, ~ condition, weights = "equal")
comparison.study3b.deescalation = summary(pairs(means.study3b.deescalation), infer = TRUE)
comparison.study3b.deescalation

joint_tests(fit.study3b.deescalation, weights = "equal")

primary$study3b = list(contrasts = bind_rows(as_tibble(comparison.study3b.sabotage) %>% mutate(outcome = "sabotage"),
  as_tibble(comparison.study3b.deescalation) %>% mutate(outcome = "deescalation")))

primary$study3b$tests = bind_rows(as_tibble(joint_tests(fit.study3b.sabotage, weights = "equal")) %>% mutate(outcome = "sabotage"),
  as_tibble(joint_tests(fit.study3b.deescalation, weights = "equal")) %>% mutate(outcome = "deescalation"))

```

### Means and confidence intervals

```{r study3b-means}

descriptives.study3b = df.study3b %>%
  select(participant, condition, sabotage, deescalation) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(outcome, condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(score), sd = sd(score))

show_table(descriptives.study3b)
primary$study3b$descriptives = descriptives.study3b

plot.means.study3b = descriptives.study3b %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n),
         lower = mean - qt(.975, n - 1) * se,
         upper = mean + qt(.975, n - 1) * se) %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("sabotage", "deescalation"),
                          labels = c("Sabotage", "De-escalation")))

show_table(plot.means.study3b)
primary$study3b$means = plot.means.study3b

```

### Mediation

```{r study3b-mediation}

df = df.study3b

mediation_results = list()
for (outcome_name in c("sabotage", "deescalation")) {
  prefix = ifelse(outcome_name == "sabotage", "Sab", "De")
  reason = ifelse(outcome_name == "sabotage", "Des", "Obl")
  m = rowMeans(df[paste0(prefix, "V", 1:3, "_", reason)])
  stopifnot(all(abs(m - df[[paste0(prefix, reason, "Avg")]]) < 1e-6))
  items = unlist(lapply(1:3, function(v) paste0(prefix, "V", v, "_", 1:5)))
  y = rowMeans(df[items], na.rm = TRUE)
  stopifnot(all(abs(y - df[[paste0(prefix, "Avg")]]) < 1e-6))
  d = data.frame(y = y, m = m, agency = as.numeric(df$condition == "Agency"))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d))
  fit_m = lm(m ~ agency, data = d)
  fit_y = lm(y ~ agency + m, data = d)


  # Resample participants; all computations remain in this Rmd.
  statistic = function(data, index) {
    b = data[index, ]
    a = lm.fit(cbind(1, b$agency), b$m)$coefficients[2]
    by = lm.fit(cbind(1, b$agency, b$m), b$y)$coefficients
    c(indirect = unname(a * by[3]), direct = unname(by[2]),
      total = unname(by[2] + a * by[3]))
  }
  set.seed(20260906)
  bootstrap = boot(d, statistic = statistic, R = 5000)
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(bootstrap$t)))
  intervals = apply(bootstrap$t, 2, quantile, probs = c(.025, .975))
  mediation_results[[outcome_name]] = tibble(
    outcome = outcome_name, mediator = ifelse(reason == "Des", "deservingness", "obligation"),
    effect = c("indirect", "direct", "total"),
    estimate = bootstrap$t0, lower = intervals[1, ], upper = intervals[2, ])
}
mediation_results = bind_rows(mediation_results)

results$study3b$mediation = mediation_results

show_table(mediation_results)

```

#### Registered condition models

```{r study2-registered-models}

fit_sabotage = lmer(score ~ condition + (1 | participant) + (1 | vignette),
                      data = filter(long, outcome == "sabotage"))
fit_deescalation = lmer(score ~ condition + (1 | participant) + (1 | vignette),
                          data = filter(long, outcome == "deescalation"))
contrasts = bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emmeans(fit_sabotage, ~ condition)), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
    mutate(outcome = "sabotage"),
  as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emmeans(fit_deescalation, ~ condition)), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
    mutate(outcome = "deescalation"))

checks = tibble(outcome = c("sabotage", "deescalation"),
               singular = c(isSingular(fit_sabotage), isSingular(fit_deescalation)),
               vignette_variance = c(as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit_sabotage))$vcov[
                 as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit_sabotage))$grp == "vignette"],
                 as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit_deescalation))$vcov[
                 as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit_deescalation))$grp == "vignette"]))

checks$optimizer_code = c(fit_sabotage@optinfo$conv$opt,
                          fit_deescalation@optinfo$conv$opt)
checks$diagnostic = vapply(list(fit_sabotage, fit_deescalation), function(model) {
  messages = model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
  if (is.null(messages)) "None" else paste(messages, collapse = "; ")
}, character(1))
stopifnot(all(checks$optimizer_code == 0))
show_table(checks)

results$study2$contrasts = contrasts
results$study2$model_checks = checks

show_table(contrasts)

```

#### Registered condition by vignette ANOVAs

```{r study2-registered-anova}

# Greenhouse-Geisser correction is an implementation choice.
anova_results = list()
for (outcome_name in c("sabotage", "deescalation")) {
  d = filter(long, outcome == outcome_name)
  contrasts(d$condition) = contr.sum(2)
  contrasts(d$vignette) = contr.sum(3)
  fit_aov = aov(score ~ condition * vignette + Error(participant / vignette), data = d)
  a = summary(fit_aov)
  wide = df[paste0(outcome_name, "_", 1:3)]
  residual_matrix = residuals(lm(as.matrix(wide) ~ df$condition))
  covariance = crossprod(residual_matrix) / (nrow(df) - 2)
  center = diag(3) - matrix(1 / 3, 3, 3)
  sc = center %*% covariance %*% center
  epsilon = sum(diag(sc))^2 / (2 * sum(sc^2))
  between = as.data.frame(a[["Error: participant"]][[1]])
  within = as.data.frame(a[["Error: participant:vignette"]][[1]])
  tab = tibble(outcome = outcome_name,
               term = c("condition", "vignette", "condition:vignette"),
               df1 = c(between$Df[1], within$Df[1:2]),
               df2 = c(between$Df[2], rep(tail(within$Df, 1), 2)),
               F = c(between$`F value`[1], within$`F value`[1:2]),
               epsilon = c(1, epsilon, epsilon)) %>%
    mutate(df1_GG = df1 * epsilon, df2_GG = df2 * epsilon,
           p_GG = pf(F, df1_GG, df2_GG, lower.tail = FALSE))
  anova_results[[outcome_name]] = tab
}
anova_results = bind_rows(anova_results)

results$study2$anova = anova_results

show_table(anova_results)

```

### Supplementary Study 1

#### Data

```{r supplementary_study1-data}

raw = read_csv("../../data/supplementary/study1/raw.csv",
               col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
               name_repair = ~ make.unique(str_trim(.x))) %>%
  slice(-(1:2)) # Qualtrics question labels and import identifiers

source = read_csv("../../data/supplementary/study1/supplied_cleaned.csv",
                  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
  slice(-1) %>% # Supplied response-code row
  rename_with(str_trim) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Condition, ExclusionReason, Exclusion), as.numeric))

selected = source %>% filter(Exclusion == 0)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(raw$ResponseId), !anyDuplicated(selected$ID),
          all(selected$ID %in% raw$ResponseId))

# Join in the supplied participant order to preserve the bootstrap draws.
raw = selected %>% select(participant = ID) %>%
  left_join(raw, by = c("participant" = "ResponseId"))
df = selected %>%
  transmute(participant = factor(ID),
            condition = factor(Condition, levels = c(1, 2),
                               labels = c("Agency", "Compliance")))
stopifnot(nrow(df) == 108, !anyNA(df$condition))

# Map the two survey branches onto the same item names.

  ~target, ~agency_column, ~compliance_column, ~coding,
  "SabotageBehaviorV1Q1", "A.actual_1a", "NA.actual_1a", "numeric",
  "SabotageBehaviorV1Q2", "A.actual_1b", "NA.actual_1b", "numeric",

  "SabotageBehaviorV1Q4", "A.actual_1d", "NA.actual_1d", "numeric",
  "SabotageBehaviorV1Q5", "A.actual_1e", "NA.actual_1e", "numeric",
  "SabotageBehaviorV2Q1", "A.actual_2a", "NA.actual_2a", "numeric",
  "SabotageBehaviorV2Q2", "A.actual_2b", "NA.actual_2b", "numeric",
  "SabotageBehaviorV2Q3", "A.actual_2c", "NA.actual_2c", "numeric",
  "SabotageBehaviorV2Q4", "A.actual_2d", "NA.actual_2d", "numeric",
```

#### Condition comparisons

```{r supplementary_study1-comparisons}

# Behavioral condition comparisons and additional deservingness outcomes.
descriptives = list()
comparisons = list()
for (measure in measures) {
  for (part in c("Overall", "Vignette 1", "Vignette 2", "Vignette 3")) {
    column = if (part == "Overall") measure else paste0(measure, "_", substr(part, 10, 10))
    d = data.frame(condition = df$condition, score = df[[column]])
    model = lm(score ~ condition, data = d)
    comparison = as.data.frame(summary(contrast(emmeans(model, ~ condition),
                    method = list("Agency - Compliance" = c(1, -1))), infer = TRUE))
    comparison$measure = measure
    comparison$part = part
    comparisons[[paste(measure, part)]] = comparison
    descriptives[[paste(measure, part)]] = d %>% group_by(condition) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(score), sd = sd(score)) %>%
      mutate(measure = measure, part = part)
  }
}
comparisons = bind_rows(comparisons)
descriptives = bind_rows(descriptives)
show_table(filter(descriptives, part == "Overall") %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
show_table(select(comparisons, measure, part, estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL, df, t.ratio, p.value) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study1 = list(descriptives = descriptives, comparisons = comparisons, score_checks = score_checks, n = nrow(df))

```

#### Registered condition by vignette ANOVAs

```{r supplementary_study1-anova}

# Greenhouse-Geisser correction is an implementation choice.
anova_results = list()
for (measure in c("SabotageBehavior", "DeescalateBehavior")) {
  wide = df[paste0(measure, "_", 1:3)]
  d = data.frame(participant = df$participant, condition = df$condition, wide) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition), names_to = "vignette", values_to = "score")
  d$vignette = factor(d$vignette)
  contrasts(d$condition) = contr.sum(2)
  contrasts(d$vignette) = contr.sum(3)
  model = aov(score ~ condition * vignette + Error(participant / vignette), data = d)
  a = summary(model)
  residual_matrix = residuals(lm(as.matrix(wide) ~ df$condition))
  covariance = crossprod(residual_matrix) / (nrow(df) - 2)
  center = diag(3) - matrix(1 / 3, 3, 3)
  sc = center %*% covariance %*% center
  epsilon = sum(diag(sc))^2 / (2 * sum(sc^2))
  between = as.data.frame(a[["Error: participant"]][[1]])
  within = as.data.frame(a[["Error: participant:vignette"]][[1]])
  tab = data.frame(measure = measure, term = c("condition", "vignette", "condition:vignette"),
    df1 = c(between$Df[1], within$Df[1:2]),
    df2 = c(between$Df[2], rep(tail(within$Df, 1), 2)),
    F = c(between$`F value`[1], within$`F value`[1:2]), epsilon = c(1, epsilon, epsilon))
  tab$df1_GG = tab$df1 * tab$epsilon
  tab$df2_GG = tab$df2 * tab$epsilon
  tab$p_GG = pf(tab$F, tab$df1_GG, tab$df2_GG, lower.tail = FALSE)
  anova_results[[measure]] = tab
}
anova_results = bind_rows(anova_results)
show_table(select(anova_results, measure, term, df1_GG, df2_GG, F, p_GG) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study1$anova = anova_results

```

#### Plots

```{r supplementary_study1-plot}

plot_data = df %>% select(participant, condition, SabotageBehavior, DeescalateBehavior) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(SabotageBehavior, DeescalateBehavior), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "score")
plot_data$outcome = factor(plot_data$outcome, levels = c("SabotageBehavior", "DeescalateBehavior"),
                           labels = c("Sabotage", "De-escalation"))
plot_summary = plot_data %>% group_by(condition, outcome) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), se = sd(score) / sqrt(n()), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(lower = mean - qt(.975, n - 1) * se, upper = mean + qt(.975, n - 1) * se)
plot.supplementary1 = ggplot(plot_data, aes(condition, score, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = .16, height = 0, seed = 1),
             alpha = .18, size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(data = plot_summary, aes(y = mean, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                width = .10, color = "black", linewidth = .8) +
  geom_point(data = plot_summary, aes(y = mean), shape = 21,
             fill = "white", color = "black", size = 4, stroke = 1) +
  geom_text(data = plot_summary,
            aes(y = .35, label = paste0("n=", n)),
            color = "#333333", size = 4.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 5), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Reported willingness\nto perform the behavior\n(1 = low; 5 = high)") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, lineheight = .95),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 25, 5.5))

plot.supplementary1

ggsave("../../figures/supplementary/study1/supplementary_study1.pdf",
       plot.supplementary1, width = 12, height = 5, bg = "white")
ggsave("../../figures/supplementary/study1/supplementary_study1.png",
       plot.supplementary1, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r supplementary_study2-anova}
  wide = df[paste0(measure, "_", 1:3)]
  d = data.frame(participant = df$participant, condition = df$condition, wide) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(participant, condition), names_to = "vignette", values_to = "score")
  d$vignette = factor(d$vignette)
  contrasts(d$condition) = contr.sum(2)
  contrasts(d$vignette) = contr.sum(3)
  model = aov(score ~ condition * vignette + Error(participant / vignette), data = d)
  a = summary(model)
  residual_matrix = residuals(lm(as.matrix(wide) ~ df$condition))
  covariance = crossprod(residual_matrix) / (nrow(df) - 2)
  center = diag(3) - matrix(1 / 3, 3, 3)
  sc = center %*% covariance %*% center
  epsilon = sum(diag(sc))^2 / (2 * sum(sc^2))
  between = as.data.frame(a[["Error: participant"]][[1]])
  within = as.data.frame(a[["Error: participant:vignette"]][[1]])
  tab = data.frame(measure = measure, term = c("condition", "vignette", "condition:vignette"),
    df1 = c(between$Df[1], within$Df[1:2]),
    df2 = c(between$Df[2], rep(tail(within$Df, 1), 2)),
    F = c(between$`F value`[1], within$`F value`[1:2]), epsilon = c(1, epsilon, epsilon))
  tab$df1_GG = tab$df1 * tab$epsilon
  tab$df2_GG = tab$df2 * tab$epsilon
  tab$p_GG = pf(tab$F, tab$df1_GG, tab$df2_GG, lower.tail = FALSE)
  anova_results[[measure]] = tab
}
anova_results = bind_rows(anova_results)
show_table(select(anova_results, measure, term, df1_GG, df2_GG, F, p_GG) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study2$anova = anova_results
```

#### Exploratory parallel mediation using vignettes 1 and 3

```{r supplementary_study2-mediation}

# Checkbox reason counts; bootstrap participants, 5,000 samples.
set.seed(20260912)
mediation_results = list()
for (measure in c("SabotageBehavior", "DeescalateBehavior")) {
  stories = c(1, 3)
  m = data.frame(agency = as.numeric(df$condition == "Agency"),
    y = rowMeans(df[paste0(measure, "_", stories)]),
    deserved = rowSums(df[paste0(measure, "V", stories, "ReasonDeserved")]),
    obligation = rowSums(df[paste0(measure, "V", stories, "ReasonObligation")]))
  stopifnot(all(complete.cases(m)))
  a_deserved = lm(deserved ~ agency, data = m)
  a_obligation = lm(obligation ~ agency, data = m)
  direct = lm(y ~ agency + deserved + obligation, data = m)
  total = lm(y ~ agency, data = m)
  paths = list("Condition to deservingness" = list(a_deserved, "agency"),
               "Condition to obligation" = list(a_obligation, "agency"),
               "Deservingness to outcome" = list(direct, "deserved"),
               "Obligation to outcome" = list(direct, "obligation"),
               "Direct condition effect" = list(direct, "agency"),
               "Total condition effect" = list(total, "agency"))
  rows = lapply(names(paths), function(label) {
    fit = paths[[label]][[1]]; term = paths[[label]][[2]]
    co = coef(summary(fit))[term, ]; ci = confint(fit, term)
    data.frame(measure = measure, effect = label, estimate = co[1],
      lower = ci[1], upper = ci[2], SE = co[2], df = df.residual(fit),
      t = co[3], p.value = co[4], row.names = NULL)
  })
  statistic = function(data, indices) {
    d = data[indices, ]; x = cbind(1, d$agency)
    a1 = lm.fit(x, d$deserved)$coefficients[2]
    a2 = lm.fit(x, d$obligation)$coefficients[2]
    b = lm.fit(cbind(x, d$deserved, d$obligation), d$y)$coefficients
    c(a1 * b[3], a2 * b[4], a1 * b[3] + a2 * b[4])
  }
  samples = boot(m, statistic, R = 5000)
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(samples$t)))
  ci = apply(samples$t, 2, quantile, probs = c(.025, .975))
  indirect = data.frame(measure = measure,
    effect = c("Indirect through deservingness", "Indirect through obligation", "Total indirect"),
    estimate = as.numeric(samples$t0), lower = ci[1, ], upper = ci[2, ])
  mediation_results[[measure]] = bind_rows(bind_rows(rows), indirect)
}
mediation_results = bind_rows(mediation_results)
show_table(filter(mediation_results, !is.na(t)) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
show_table(filter(mediation_results, is.na(t)) %>% select(measure, effect, estimate, lower, upper) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study2$mediation = mediation_results
```

#### Condition comparisons

```{r supplementary_study3-comparisons}

descriptives = list()
comparisons = list()
for (measure in measures) {
  for (part in c("Overall", "Vignette 1", "Vignette 2", "Vignette 3")) {
    column = if (part == "Overall") measure else paste0(measure, "_", substr(part, 10, 10))
    d = data.frame(condition = df$condition, score = df[[column]])
    model = lm(score ~ condition, data = d)
    comparison = as.data.frame(summary(contrast(emmeans(model, ~ condition),
                    method = list("Agency - Compliance" = c(1, -1))), infer = TRUE))
    comparison$measure = measure
    comparison$part = part
    comparisons[[paste(measure, part)]] = comparison
    descriptives[[paste(measure, part)]] = d %>% group_by(condition) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(score), sd = sd(score)) %>%
      mutate(measure = measure, part = part)
  }
}
comparisons = bind_rows(comparisons)
descriptives = bind_rows(descriptives)
show_table(filter(descriptives, part == "Overall") %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
show_table(select(comparisons, measure, part, estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL, df, t.ratio, p.value) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
```

```{r supplementary_study3-mediation}
  ci = apply(samples$t, 2, quantile, probs = c(.025, .975))
  indirect = data.frame(measure = measure,
    effect = c("Indirect through deservingness", "Indirect through obligation", "Total indirect"),
    estimate = as.numeric(samples$t0), lower = ci[1, ], upper = ci[2, ])
  mediation_results[[measure]] = bind_rows(bind_rows(rows), indirect)
}
mediation_results = bind_rows(mediation_results)
show_table(filter(mediation_results, !is.na(t)) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
show_table(filter(mediation_results, is.na(t)) %>% select(measure, effect, estimate, lower, upper) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study3$mediation = mediation_results
```

```{r supplementary_study4-data}
  mutate(vignette = as.numeric(vignette))
stopifnot(all(score_checks$maximum_difference_from_supplied < .001))

# Average answered items within each story, then weight stories equally.
df = df %>%
  left_join(story_scores %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = c(measure, vignette), values_from = score),
            by = "participant") %>%
  left_join(story_scores %>%
              group_by(participant, measure) %>%
              summarise(score = mean(score)) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = score),
            by = "participant") %>%
  mutate(participant = factor(participant))
```

#### Condition comparisons

```{r supplementary_study4-comparisons}

descriptives = list()
comparisons = list()
for (measure in measures) {
  for (part in c("Overall", "Vignette 1", "Vignette 2", "Vignette 3")) {
    column = if (part == "Overall") measure else paste0(measure, "_", substr(part, 10, 10))
    d = data.frame(condition = df$condition, score = df[[column]])
    model = lm(score ~ condition, data = d)
    comparison = as.data.frame(summary(contrast(emmeans(model, ~ condition),
                    method = list("Agency - Compliance" = c(1, -1))), infer = TRUE))
    comparison$measure = measure
    comparison$part = part
    comparisons[[paste(measure, part)]] = comparison
    descriptives[[paste(measure, part)]] = d %>% group_by(condition) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(score), sd = sd(score)) %>%
      mutate(measure = measure, part = part)
  }
}
comparisons = bind_rows(comparisons)
descriptives = bind_rows(descriptives)
show_table(filter(descriptives, part == "Overall") %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
show_table(select(comparisons, measure, part, estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL, df, t.ratio, p.value) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study4 = list(descriptives = descriptives, comparisons = comparisons, score_checks = score_checks, n = nrow(df))
```

#### Registered mediation with one mediator at a time

```{r supplementary_study4-mediation}

# Four separate paths; bootstrap method was not specified in the registration.
set.seed(20260914)
mediation_results = list()
for (measure in c("SabotageBehavior", "DeescalateBehavior")) {
  for (reason in c("Deserved", "Obligation")) {
    d = data.frame(agency = as.numeric(df$condition == "Agency"), y = df[[measure]],
      mediator = rowMeans(df[paste0(measure, "V", 1:3, "Reason", reason)]))
    a = lm(mediator ~ agency, data = d)
    b = lm(y ~ agency + mediator, data = d)
    total = lm(y ~ agency, data = d)
    paths = list("Condition to reason" = list(a, "agency"), "Reason to outcome" = list(b, "mediator"),
                 "Direct condition effect" = list(b, "agency"), "Total condition effect" = list(total, "agency"))
    rows = lapply(names(paths), function(label) {
      fit = paths[[label]][[1]]; term = paths[[label]][[2]]
      co = coef(summary(fit))[term, ]; ci = confint(fit, term)
      data.frame(measure = measure, reason = reason, effect = label, estimate = co[1],
        lower = ci[1], upper = ci[2], SE = co[2], df = df.residual(fit), t = co[3], p.value = co[4], row.names = NULL)
    })
    statistic = function(data, indices) {
      d = data[indices, ]; a = lm.fit(cbind(1, d$agency), d$mediator)$coefficients[2]
      b = lm.fit(cbind(1, d$agency, d$mediator), d$y)$coefficients[3]
      a * b
    }
    samples = boot(d, statistic, R = 5000)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(samples$t)))
    ci = quantile(samples$t, c(.025, .975))
    indirect = data.frame(measure = measure, reason = reason, effect = "Indirect",
      estimate = as.numeric(samples$t0), lower = ci[1], upper = ci[2])
    mediation_results[[paste(measure, reason)]] = bind_rows(bind_rows(rows), indirect)
  }
}
mediation_results = bind_rows(mediation_results)
show_table(filter(mediation_results, effect != "Indirect") %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
show_table(filter(mediation_results, effect == "Indirect") %>% select(measure, reason, estimate, lower, upper) %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study4$mediation = mediation_results

```

#### Exploratory demographic correlations

```{r supplementary-correlations}

correlations = list()
for (measure in c("SabotageBehavior", "DeescalateBehavior")) {
  for (variable in c("Age", "Income", "PoliticsEconomic", "PoliticsSocial", "JobYears",
                     "JobObligation", "JobTalkDirectly", "JobServiceExperienceYears")) {
    value = as.numeric(selected[[variable]])
    keep = !is.na(value) & !is.na(df[[measure]])
    test = cor.test(df[[measure]][keep], value[keep])
    correlations[[paste(measure, variable)]] = data.frame(measure = measure,
      variable = variable, n = sum(keep), r = unname(test$estimate), p.value = test$p.value)
  }
}
correlations = bind_rows(correlations)
show_table(correlations %>% mutate(measure = unname(measure_labels[measure])))
results$supplementary_study4$correlations = correlations
```

## MODEL CHECKS

```{r model-checks}

models = list("study1.sabotage" = fit.study1.sabotage,
  "study2.sabotage" = fit.study2.sabotage,
  "study2.deescalation" = fit.study2.deescalation,
  "study3a.sabotage" = fit.study3a.sabotage,
  "study3a.deescalation" = fit.study3a.deescalation,
  "study3b.sabotage" = fit.study3b.sabotage,
  "study3b.deescalation" = fit.study3b.deescalation)

model_checks = map_dfr(models, function(model) {
  tibble(singular = isSingular(model),
         optimizer_code = model@optinfo$conv$opt,
         diagnostic = if (is.null(model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)) "None" else
           paste(model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages, collapse = "; "),
         participant_variance = as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))$vcov[1],
         residual_variance = sigma(model)^2)
}, .id = "model")

show_table(model_checks)
stopifnot(all(model_checks$optimizer_code == 0), !any(model_checks$singular))
results$primary = primary
results$primary_checks = model_checks

```
